import_provenance.original_title: A one-pass approximation scheme for random-order streaming matching
import_provenance.original_statement: Can a single-pass algorithm find a (1−ε)-approximate maximum matching, for every fixed ε>0, using O_ε(n·polylog n) space when graph edges arrive in uniformly random order? Assadi and Behnezhad broke the 2/3 approximation barrier, but an approximation scheme remains a substantial open target.
